visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with glasses and a ponytail, wearing a yellow t-shirt and a floral apron over dark pants, stands in a brightly lit modern living room. She holds a white bed sheet or cloth and adjusts her glasses with an annoyed expression while looking off-camera. The background shows a white dresser, a mirror, and a computer desk with monitors in a neighboring room. (2) A young man wearing a brown t-shirt and carrying a large tan bag and a green motorcycle helmet enters the frame. He gestures towards the woman while speaking. The setting remains the same indoor residential area with neutral-toned walls and tile flooring. The camera is handheld, capturing natural movements as the characters interact within the domestic space. (3) The scene shifts to the man sitting on a sofa or unmade bed, focused on a handheld gaming device. The woman approaches him, holding a large wooden kitchen spoon and pointing it at him threateningly. She holds a green rag in her other hand, emphasizing her role as a frustrated housewife. The room is cluttered with papers and a fan. (4) A transition occurs where the woman is shown lying down on a pristine white mattress with a grey headboard. She looks extremely comfortable and relieved, her eyes closed. The man reappears dressed in a dark blue formal suit and white gloves, acting as a butler. He stands over her, pointing at the mattress and later lying down himself to demonstrate comfort. (5) Close-up shots of the mattress layers are shown, revealing a blue grid-like texture and different foam layers being pressed by a gloved hand to show elasticity. The butler character jumps and dances vigorously on the mattress next to a tall glass of water which remains perfectly still, demonstrating motion isolation. The lighting is bright and studio-like. (6) The final phase shows the butler and the woman together on the bed, looking at the camera as promotional text and a discount code appear. The scene ends with a return to the initial characters in the same room, with the woman expressing extreme satisfaction with the product while giving a thumbs up.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a loud, high-pitched female voice yelling "Ian Lee!" in a mixture of Mandarin and Taiwanese. Her tone is aggressive and authoritative. We hear the sharp, percussive sound of clothing being shaken. The BGM is a very low-volume, upbeat comedic synth track with a moderate tempo. (2) A male voice responds with a lower pitch and a sarcastic, casual tone. His speech is fast and flows into the woman's shouting. A distinct "whoosh" sound effect marks a quick visual cut. The ambient noise is minimal, suggesting a clean indoor recording with light room tone. (3) The woman's voice rises in volume and arousal as she counts "Three!", punctuated by a "ding" sound effect. The BGM maintains its playful, rhythmic character. There are brief incidental noises of footsteps and fabric rustling that are well-integrated into the mix. (4) A dramatic "whoosh" transition leads to a shift in tone. The male voice becomes a professional narrator with a friendly, welcoming pitch. He sings a short, melodic phrase with clear vibrato. The BGM swells into a bright, cinematic pop track with shimmering synth textures. (5) The narrator's speech rate is fast but enunciated, explaining product features like "AirGrid." Frequent "ding" and "sparkle" sound effects are layered over the speech to highlight visual text. The music remains energetic and positive in a major key, providing a constant emotional lift. (6) A loud thumping sound of jumping occurs, but it is muffled to emphasize the lack of vibration. The male voice expresses excitement and high arousal. The audio ends with a high-fidelity vocal delivery of a discount code, followed by a final comedic exchange.
